study.question: Observed limitation: full mean+C/T achieves validation AUC 0.61848329 versus attention+C/T 0.61866377; joint histogram+C/T is 0.61762244 and its independence reconstruction 0.61757329. These replacements confound learned category/brand content with learned action/log-age content. Which component accounts for the residual mean-summary benefit, and can a small-vocabulary action/time embedding summary retain it without history identity embedding lookups?
study.hypothesis: Provisional hypothesis: a learned action/log-age marginal readout can recover some of the residual benefit attributed loosely to semantic history. Use h_I=mean(e_category+e_brand), h_X=mean(e_action+e_log_age), and a 16-wide h selected from {h_I+h_X,h_I,h_X,0}, retaining the exact supported C/T blocks. The primary compact candidate uses h_X, not a fixed coarse histogram. A competing hypothesis is that h_I is necessary. Both are prospective; prior outcomes do not identify either mechanism.

nearest_work.difference: Exact archived v4 content-sha256:5fee25f33f375e51b3ee9417d376ff9dbe2ea3628c932a7679ddfeb0feaaade2, primary lines 219-277: group-wise embedding pooling and target-activated weighted sums are inherited ideas, and DIN already preserves intensity without softmax. This local factorial decomposes the additive field-adapted mean, keeps explicit target counts/freshness, and tests removal of history identity versus action/log-age gradients. It is neither exact DIN reproduction nor a general novelty claim.

inherited_components: Host-owned data identities, causal feature construction, labels, scorer, splits and resource ledger; raw inputs are not exposed in this jail, so existing host trial receipts establish the starting point rather than a new raw-data audit.
Static embeddings and [128,64] ReLU MLP from baseline_reference.py; all learned module shapes and construction order from candidate.py.
Exact existing all/category/brand/joint-by-action count C=log1p(n)/log(129) and conditional freshness T=mean(exp(-age/86400)), empty cells zero.
All-event uniform masked mean from g0-r0003-global_mean; no target gate or event scoring.
Dormant attention kept for registered-capacity and initialization matching; unchanged optimizer and objective.
study.proposed_difference: Replace the mixed learned summary by the action/log-age-only summary as a compact candidate and the category/brand-only summary as its competing candidate; complete the 2x2 with an exact full-mean anchor and a zero-summary scalar C/T control. The compact candidate needs only 5 action and 33 recency embedding rows in its learned history branch, while exact target C/T still use category/brand buckets. This is forward-branch simplification, not registered model compression: shared static identity tables remain, and dormant action/recency/scorer parameters are explicitly counted. The action/time summary is a learned additive marginal representation; no action-age association or sequence-order mechanism is claimed. General novelty remains unverified.
predictions: Primary candidate prediction: context_only has higher AUC than scalar_only and loses no more than a predeclared practical screening margin 0.0003 AUC against full_mean. This is an operational selection tolerance, not a statistical noninferiority claim.
Competing prediction: identity_only exceeds scalar_only and context_only, indicating that dropping history category/brand embeddings is the consequential loss in prior fixed-statistic replacements.

Compute paired AUC differences full_mean-identity_only, context_only-scalar_only, full_mean-context_only and identity_only-scalar_only, plus the descriptive interaction (full_mean-identity_only)-(context_only-scalar_only). AUC interaction is not an intrinsic information decomposition.

The full_mean cell should reproduce the authorized 0.6184832906929091 AUC under the same seed and host recipe. Any discrepancy must be resolved before interpreting differences. Context-only should skip identity-history embedding forward lookups, but end-to-end speed and memory benefits require host measurement.

Implementation diagnostics should show masked/empty summaries equal zero, C/T identical across cells, and full mean equal identity mean plus context mean within floating-point tolerance. Slice contrasts use existing bins/counts; sparse slices remain exploratory.
falsifiers: context_only failing to improve scalar_only, or trailing full_mean by more than 0.0003 AUC, rejects this compact implementation as a quality-preserving replacement at seed 42; it does not refute all compact action/time representations.
A context-only gain that disappears against scalar_only, or a benefit explained equally by the identity-only cell, does not establish a unique action/time mechanism.

If full_mean differs from the existing matched anchor, masks fail, summaries are nonfinite, or registered shapes/construction differ, treat the contrast as an implementation or reproduction failure and retain its charged cost.
An apparent AUC improvement that fails paired seeds or trades off unacceptable Logloss/cost is not repeated support or an established efficiency gain.
alternative_explanations: Removal changes active history gradient paths, summary magnitude and effective capacity despite equal registered shapes. A loss is not a proof that information is intrinsically indispensable.
The single-seed screen cannot distinguish small effects from seed variation. Re-executions of seed 42 are reproducibility checks, not independent repetitions.
The identity/context split groups category with brand and action with recency; it does not isolate effects within either pair.
The fixed histogram branch used different time bins and transformations. A learned context readout gain could reflect representation/optimization rather than new time information.
C/T already encode identity matches, action counts and freshness, and summary removal does not remove these underlying inputs from the whole model.
The observed histogram Logloss 0.19583568 is better than full mean 0.19611347 despite worse AUC; quality conclusions depend on the declared primary metric.
Publisher snapshot timing remains undocumented; point-in-time production validity and transfer outside this benchmark are unverified.
